name: Hairy Bittercress
caution: A safe, mild mustard; harvest from unsprayed ground. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A small rosette of round-lobed leaflets that fires its ripe seed pods at a touch. One of the first fresh things in a winter garden.

sections.title: On the trail
sections.body: Snip the whole young rosette for a fresh peppery cress; it fades fast once it flowers.
